title: Amulet of the Harpers
summary: Gain Advantage on Wisdom saves and a Shield reaction once per Long Rest.

fields.Effect: Advantage on Wisdom saving throws. Cast Shield as a Reaction once per Long Rest when about to be hit, for +5 AC and protection from Magic Missile.
fields.Base value: 125 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Item-cast exception: The pinned spell source reports that item-granted Shield does not retain its usual beneficial effects until the start of the next turn. Do not count on protection against follow-up attacks.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
